title: How Evaluation Choices Distort the Outcome of Generative Drug Discovery

bias_targets.methodology: Systematically varying the size of generated molecular libraries (from 10^2 to 10^6 designs) across different chemical language models to measure how sample size confounds and skews generative evaluation metrics like Fréchet ChemNet Distance (FCD), Fréchet Descriptor Distance (FDD), and uniqueness.

Analyzing molecule selection strategies by binning generated designs into likelihood deciles and measuring generation frequencies to demonstrate how frequency- or likelihood-based ranking can disproportionately favor low-quality, repetitive molecular scaffolds.
